source_instruction: The owner stated that issue #1 was finished with their checks. Checked original entries are approved; unchecked original entries are declined.
issue_body_at_collection:
Review relevant English-language television **one debut year at a time**, covering **2000–2009 only**.

This issue reorganizes the current **150 relevant recommendations** into yearly shortlists, ordered editorially within each year. The number of worthwhile picks varies by year: **no fixed annual quota and no requirement to fill another decade-wide batch**.

**Review key:** checked boxes preserve your **100 existing approvals**; unchecked show boxes are the **50 candidates still awaiting review**. Regrouping does not approve those candidates automatically.

## Rules for this review

- List each distinct series or eligible edition **once, in its original premiere year**. Later seasons, episodes, broadcasters, streaming services, reruns and narrator changes do not create another entry.
- Use the earliest television or eligible streaming premiere for that edition, including aired pilots and introductory miniseries treated as part of the same series. A later regular-season launch does not make it a new debut.
- Distinct remakes, reboots, remasters and separately identifiable re-release editions may have their own entries under their own premiere years, following the existing uniqueness rules.
- Include English-language productions originating in North America or Britain, including qualifying co-productions and streaming originals: scripted TV, reality TV, miniseries and docuseries. Major game shows must have more than five seasons for the specific edition; preserve the standing approvals for The Price Is Right, Jeopardy!, Wheel of Fortune and Family Feud.
- Exclude animation/cartoons, standalone films, TV movies and side movies, news/current affairs, local-only programmes, sports coverage and talk shows. Keep the existing exclusions for pure variety, music and instructional/classroom programmes. Feature-length episodes within eligible series are allowed.
- Show only the title and its IMDb/TMDB or equivalent series link under each year. Keep summaries, images, season lists and individual release dates out of the browsing lists.

- [x] **2010–2019:** [Yearly shortlist prepared in #3](https://github.com/Joebannerlord/TV-Tracking/issues/3). Individual show review continues there. Use calendar-decade boundaries; 2020 begins the next decade.

The 1990s shortlist is prepared in [#2](https://github.com/Joebannerlord/TV-Tracking/issues/2), and the 2010s shortlist in [#3](https://github.com/Joebannerlord/TV-Tracking/issues/3). Individual show review continues in those issues. The **1960s, 1970s and 1980s are outside this regrouping**. No 2020s shortlist has been started.

## Preserved research

The complete original recommendation batches remain in RAW for independent reviewers: [picks 1–50](https://github.com/Joebannerlord/TV-Tracking/blob/main/RAW/2000s.md), [picks 51–100](https://github.com/Joebannerlord/TV-Tracking/blob/main/RAW/2000s-batch-2.md), and [picks 101–150](https://github.com/Joebannerlord/TV-Tracking/blob/main/RAW/2000s-batch-3.md).

Premiere placement and series identities come from the source references in the [approved catalogue data](https://github.com/Joebannerlord/TV-Tracking/blob/14c4ea7332a608d702f23911762ddbbf8a655d08/data/2000s.json) and [third-batch research](https://github.com/Joebannerlord/TV-Tracking/blob/14c4ea7332a608d702f23911762ddbbf8a655d08/data/proposals/2000s-batch-3.json). For the Canadian debut-year placement of Survivorman, [IMDb's distributor record lists OLN Canada in 2004](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0770659/companycredits/); the exact premiere day remains flagged in the research data.
